name: Mango Sherbet Jeeter Infused Pre-Roll | 1g
description: Mango Sherbet blends juicy mango sweetness with a creamy sherbet twist, rounded out by a hint of earth. The buds are resinous and fragrant, filling the air with tropical fruit. A flavor this smooth is basically a vacation rolled into flower form.
